batting.name: RT Ponting
batting.dismissal: c R Ashwin b AS Rajpoot

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b DJ Bravo

batting.name: AT Rayudu
batting.dismissal: c DP Nannes b B Laughlin

batting.name: DR Smith
batting.dismissal: c DJ Bravo b R Ashwin

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c RT Ponting b MG Johnson

batting.name: DJ Bravo
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b PP Ojha

batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: c KA Pollard b MM Patel

batting.name: R Ashwin
batting.dismissal: c KA Pollard b Harbhajan Singh

balls.text: no no no, Bravo bowls the wrong length at the wrong pace, it is normal paced delivery outside off, Pollard says thank you as he biffs it over long on with ease
slower delivery wide outside off, the batsman waits and punches it to long on for a single

length ball, Bhajji gives this one mighty swing across the line, gets everything behind that, but it goes straight up in the air, really really high and when it comes down, it has just cleared the boundary at deep midwicket
he punches it to long-off and wants to come back for a couple, but Harbhajan wasn't even looking, Pollard is upset, he wanted the strike
he bends down on his knee to ramp it over the keeper, but Bravo bowls it slow and the batsman is left waiting for it, it goes over him, few pleasant words exchanged again
bowls a full length delivery outside off, Harbhajan clubs it down the ground to long on
fuller delivery on the stumps, Harbhajan squeezes it out towards deep midwicket
bowls a good yorker outside off which Pollard digs it out behind point and calls for a single that brings up his half-century
length delivery outside off, he biffs it over non-striker's head, it's flat and makes it to the boundary in no time
tries a yorker but it's a low full toss which Harbhajan is only able to push as far as long on
now Harbhajan joins in the fun, it was a half-volley outside off and he slaps it over extra cover for a one-bounce four
now gets his yorker right outside off, Harbhajan doesn't get any bat on that
and another delivery wide outside off, this was fuller though but Harbhajan spotted it early and left it alone
bowls it wide length delivery, the batsman just lets it go and earns an extra
it is a full toss on off stump which Harbhajan flat-bats to deep midwicket, straight to the fielder
bowls a flighted yorker on the middle stump, the batsman digs it out to the leg side towards midwicket
and he makes it up big time, slams the flatter delivery outside off over extra cover
this time he punches it to long on but turns down the single
tosses it up wide outside off, but Pollard, surprisingly, lets it go through
bowls a low full toss on the pads, the batsman ends up hitting it back to the bowler
he punches it off the front foot to the off side, but is not able to beat the man at extra cover, keep the strike though
bowls short and wide, Pollard stretches out but doesn't make any contact, it's too wide though
low full toss, it looked like it was a chip, but this one has cleared long-on, just some work of devilish wrists..wow
bowls back of length a bit wide outside off, Pollard tries to punch it without getting closer to the line, gets beaten
full delivery, yorker on off stump, Pollard smacks it back to the bowler, who catches it and he shapes to throw it back at the batsman, all within a second, words exchanged..
short of length delivery on off stump, the batsman waits and pushes it to deep cover off the back foot
length delivery angling in, Harbhajan punches it to cover
shorter and quicker outside off, the batsman looks to punch it but ends up chopping it back to the bowler
slightly fuller, Pollard doesn't think twice about it and sends it soaring over long-on with a powerful hit
another one of those carrom-balls, the batsman looks to work it away to the leg side but ends up defending it
carrom-ball on the middle stump, the batsman defends it easily
short delivery this time and Harbhajan swats it to deep midwicket with a wristy pull
he tosses it up, draws the batsman forward and the ball then turns in, the inside edge save the batsman
pulls the length back this time and angles it across the right hander, who gets beaten as he tries to poke at it
stays in the crease to the angled delivery and opens the face to run it down to third man
bowls a low full toss outside off, the batsman comes forward and drives it to deep cover
short delivery at the tall man, Pollard ducks right under it, as low as the stumps
length delivery on the middle stump, the batsman goes back to defend but gets an inside edge down to fine leg
bowls a good yorker first up, Pollard digs it out towards long off for a single
bowls it back of the hand, it is loopy and full, the batsman tries to smash it down the ground but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg
bowls the carrom ball and it sucks Harbhajan into a drive, then goes past the outside edge
he comes forward and defends the length delivery towards midwicket
he comes forward and dabs it towards cover for a quick single
tossed up delivery, Harbhajan clears his front foot and tries to smack it, doesn't get hold of it and it goes towards deep midwicket along the floor
bowls a flatter delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it towards midwicket
but this one is slightly fuller and that is all Pollard needs to practice his swing, easily sent deep into the stands, very easily
another quicker one outside off, the batsman tries to push it to off, gets an inside edge
is that a drop! Looks like, it was a quicker one and Pollard punched it straight back to the bowler, who bends for the low chance but can't quite hold on to it
bowls a slider towards the pads, the batsman misses it and gets hit on the pads
quicker delivery outside off, the batsman pushes it to deep cover
quicker delivery outside off, the batsman defends it off the back foot

caught at long-on! Oh no, there goes another one! Ashwin tosses it right up and Smith takes the invitation and smacks it straight down the ground, but the ball was too full and he didn't get right under it, it goes as far as long-on where Bravo gobbles it up and does a little jig
shorter length delivery on the middle and leg line, it is worked towards square leg for a single
another flatter delivery outside off, the batsman goes back and punches it to long off
now he waits on the back foot to this flatter delivery outside off and cuts it to deep backward point
tossed up outside off, the batsman goes for a drive but inside edges it to midwicket
bowls a flatter delivery on the off stump, the batsman goes right back in the crease and defends
bowls another slower one, but this time it is going down the leg stump, the batsman gets hit on the pads
slower delivery on off stump, it's full too, but hello, Pollard times it so well and just in the perfect spot through leg side, it bisects the fielder at long-on and deep midwicket, beautiful
back of length delivery wide outside off, the batsman comes forward and punches it to cover

caught at third man! Another one goes back to the dugout! It was a slower delivery outside off, the length was fuller and that drew Rayudu into a hoick, but the batsman gets a big leading edge which goes high in the night sky before settling into the hands of Nannes in the deep. First wicket for  Laughlin
length delivery outside off stump, the batsman tries to whip it to the leg side, but gets hit on the pads, they run a single
fuller length delivery down the leg side, called a wide
fuller length delivery on off, the batsman throws his bat at that one, looks to hit it straight but doesn't get much timing, it drops short of the long-on fielder
he throws his bat at this slightly fuller one, but doesn't get hold of it, ends up hitting it towards deep midwicket off the inside half of the bat
fuller this time, Rayudu comes forward and drives it down to long-on
he takes a couple of steps down the pitch, the bowler fires it in quicker, defended towards midwicket
quicker delivery on off stump, punched towards midwicket
bowls a slider on the middle stump, the batsman comes forward to drive but gets an inside edge towards deep midwicket
pushed through on off stump, the batsman pushes it to long on for a single
back of length delivery on off, he dabs it towards cover point and thinks about a single, is rightly sent back
fuller length delivery on the pads, this time he goes to the other side with a well-timed flick, another boundary at deep backward square leg
short of length delivery with some width outside off, Pollard stands on his toes and punches it through point
get a bouncer first delivery, but this one is too short and he gets under it easily

the umpire takes ages to decide, but this looked plumb the moment it hit the pad. It was a length delivery and the batsman chose to go back to it in an attempt to flick it to the leg, he misses and gets hit on the knee-roll in front of middle and leg
comes down the pitch and times this supremely through midwicket, oh that just skims on the grass.. beautiful shot
length delivery on off stump, the batsman waits in the crease and opens the bat face to dab it towards gully
length delivery on off stump, the batsman comes forward and punches it to long-on
length delivery on the pads, the batsman waits and flicks it down to fine leg
short of length delivery on the body, the batsman arches back and pulls it to deep square leg
it is short of length outside off, not much room, but the batsman cuts it late to third man
bowls gentle medium pace, short of length on off stump, the batsman dabs it towards gully for an easy single
short and wide delivery outside off, DK tries to pull it to the leg side, but gets beaten as it's too far
short of length delivery, comes with some width, the batsman cuts it hard past point
he bowls a fuller length delivery, but this one goes down the leg side, called a wide
here comes the slower delivery, the batsman defends it to the leg side
he waits on the back foot and plays the length delivery late, third man does well to cut it off
short of length delivery outside off, Rayudu punches it to deep cover off the back foot

he is gone, Rohit is gone! Bravo does it off the first ball! He bowled it on a length and the ball cuts into the batsman, Rohit is surprised by the movement and gets a faint inside edge which Dhoni takes diving to his left. Another big wicket
now he makes the team pay for the drop, smokes a pull to deep square leg of a short delivery
short and wide, it's crashed with some power to the left of Raina, who drops it, hard chance, but it was in his hands
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman pushes it towards wide mid-on for a single
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman takes a couple of steps down the pitch and dabs it to deep midwicket for a single
short of length delivery outside off, DK is quick to pounce on that, he hammers it through midwicket with a powerful pull
bowls a length delivery angling into the batsman, Rohit looks to flick it, but gets hit on the pads
he smacks it back to the bowler, who is not able to get out of the way, saves four runs for the team
another quick short delivery on the body, DK takes his eyes off as he fends it towards square leg
back of length delivery on off, the batsman guides it down to third man
it was a full-toss outside off, the batsman punches it towards mid-off, Vijay comes in and hits the stumps direct, the richochet goes towards deep square leg

oh what a sitter! Rajpoot drops the simplest of chances at fine-leg! it was a short delivery and Rohit goes for a pull, the ball comes in a bit quicker into him and it takes a healthy top edge where Rajpoot fluffs it.
length delivery on off stump, the batsman comes forward and defends it to off
short of length delivery outside off, the batsman waits on the back foot and dabs  it down to third man
fuller delivery, swinging away, it's that cover drive again, he comes forward, plays it late, just times it through cover beautifully.. sigh..
he comes forward and dabs the length delivery to point
length delivery on the off stump, the batsman tries to defend it to off, ends up chopping it to the keeper
bowls it short of length and wide outside off, it swings further away and the batsman leaves it alone

caught at slip! Expecting Ponting to charge again, the bowler bowls a quick bouncer and Ponting is a bit early on his pull, the ball takes a leading edge and flies flat towards first slip where Ashwin takes a smart head-high catch. Another big blow, a big first wicket for Rajpoot
he gives the bowler charge, but he is a bit early, the bowler bowls it a bit wide and the batsman is beaten
fuller delivery on off stump, bit of a shape into the batsman, Ponting looks for a drive but gets an inside edge to the leg side
he steers this down to third man to pick up another easy single
walks across to the off side a bit and tries to whip the full delivery on pads to leg side, gets hit on the pads and it rolls down to fine leg
low full-toss outside off, the batsman gets sucked into a loose drive, he punches it in the air towards mid-off, the ball just drops short of the fielder
back of length delivery on the body, Ponting pulls it down to deep backward square leg
back of length delivery angling across the right-hander, DK chops it down to third man for a single
another tight delivery on off stump, the batsman stays in the crease and dabs it towards point to pick up another single
he stays in the crease and waits for the ball to swing, then guides it down to third man
length delivery on off stump, the batsman comes forward and punches it to mid-off, calls for a quick one
comes forward and crunches the length delivery outside off through cover point
loose shot outside off from DK, he throws his bat at a length ball and gets beaten
gets some good swing outside off, it was on a fuller length and swings away as the batsman lets it go.
length delivery on off stump, the batsman defends it to the off side and immediately calls for a single, he dives in at the other end to make it through

he is out first ball! The umpire takes his time, the bowler continues appealing and finally gets the decision in his favour. The ball was on length, pitched on leg stump, the batsman played across the line and gets hit right in front. Tendlya takes ages to walk off the pitch, but that was as plumb as you get but that would have hit the top of leg stump
he walks down the pitch to a fuller delivery wide outside off, opens the face and then runs it down to third-man
length delivery on off stump, 142 kph, the batsman goes a touch across and defends it to the leg side
length delivery on off stump, the batsman pushes it with soft hands towards cover for a quick single and Raina runs in and pushes it past mid-off allowing an extra run
full swinging delivery on the pads, Ricky flicks it, but straight to square leg
another short ball, it follows the batsman who ducks under it, but it's an ok delivery, Mumbai win, Ponting is all smiles, gives a hug to Munaf, DK and Polly.. and others in the queue..
another short delivery that goes over the bat, to the keeper
moves outside the leg stump, Munaf follows him with a short one, the batsman swats it back to the bowler like he is getting rid of an irritating fly
fuller delivery on off stump, the batsman drives it to extra cover where Ponting dives and makes a half-stop, gives away two, but he doesn't mind it at this stage
length delivery outside off, the batsman swings and misses

Polly has done it! He has pulled off another stunner at the boundary! It was a length delivery, one of those which disappeared in the previous over, it looked like this was going out of the ground too, but Polly intercepts just in time with the tall frame of his, outstretched arms, bucket palms, is that the match?
slower delivery on off, it's full too, the batsman pushes it to long off for a single
see it sailing over deep midwicket everytime it is bowled on a length on the stumps - that is one lesson Mitchell Johnson would learn from this delivery
length delivery on off stump is mauled on the leg side, Bhajji at deep midwicket does well to come around it and keep the batsmen to two
he gives away an extra run with another wide outside off
fuller delivery outside off, he punches it to mid-off, there was a single but he stays back again..
length delivery on off stump, he tries to swing it big, but ends up dragging it to deep midwicket, he turns down the single again
this time it's a good yorker just outside off, Dhoni tries to whip it to the leg side but doesn't make any contact
bowls it full and wide outside off, Dhoni lets it go and it's a wide
length delivery on off, the batsman chips it over the bowlers head, it doesn't go too far but Dhoni turns down Rajpoot's request for his first IPL runs..
he bowls a slower delivery outside off, the batsman was too eager to push it to the leg side and falls over a bit, gets an inside edge and the ball hits the stumps..
bowls a high full toss on the stumps, the batsman punches it to extra cover for a single
bowls a slower wider delivery, this one is wide indeed
bowls a fuller wider delivery and Dhoni takes a tiny step down the pitch and threads the gap at cover point with a wristy slash..
bowls a short of length delivery wide outside off, Dhoni lets it go and it's called a wide, a harsh call lets say
bowls a short delivery from wide of the crease, Dhoni swivels and guides this past the short fine leg fielder for another boundary
he serves up a full delivery on off stump and Dhoni clubs it straight over long-off with one powerful swing off the bat...96 metres they say
bowls a quick yorker on the stumps, the batsman dabs it to the leg side and takes a single to keep the strike
he charges down the track, but Harbhajan bowls it short, Ashwin goes swinging like its the sixties anyway and doesn't strike it too well, there is Pollard there who swallows this up
bowls a high full toss wide outside off, he is lucky to get away with it as Dhoni swats it to long on
he skips down the track and dabs the length delivery to the leg side for a single
bowls a flatter delivery outside off, Dhoni mishits it towards midwicket and calls for a couple, but Ashwin slips while turning..
low full toss, Dhoni bends his knee, gets under it and murders it over cow corner, absolutely belts it, that is deep into the sea of yellow
fuller delivery on the stumps, Dhoni looks to drive it straight down the ground but gets an inside edge to square leg
short of length delivery on the stumps, he pulls it to deep midwicket to give his captain the strike
bowls a slower delivery on the middle which Ashwin pushes to midwicket and runs halfway, Dhoni sends him back, but a high throw from Ojha saves him
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman pushes it to mid-off off the front foot
he goes after this one too, but ends up getting an inside edge on to the middle stump, Munaf is pumped, those glaring eyes help Jadeja find the way back to his dugout..
he bowls a slower delivery on  a fuller length wide outside off, Jadeja gets after it immediately and smashes it all along the ground to deep extra cover boundary
another quicker delivery and Jadeja tries to guide it to the off side, but gets an inside edge past the stumps
bowls a quicker delivery on the stumps, the batsman punches it down the ground to long on
he makes the mistake of bowling a low full toss to Dhoni, who clubs it with some power straight down the ground, one bounce and four
quicker delivery on the middle stump, the batsman goes back to whip it, but gets an inside edge on to his pads, the ball rolls to the off side and they take a single
clears his front foot out and launches a length delivery straight over the bowler's head, it keeps Polly interested near the boundary, but is just out of the reach
pushed through on the stumps, Jadeja comes forward and defends
full and wide outside off, Dhoni pounces on it with a powerful drive through extra cover, there was no chance for the fielder in the deep to stop that one
short of length delivery outside off, the third man was in and Dhoni gets under it and cuts it over the fielder for a much-needed boundary
he bowls a short delivery, but this is down the leg side and Jadeja doesn't get hold of it, plays a meek shot towards fine leg
back of length delivery on off stump, Dhoni dabs it to point for a quick single
length delivery angling on the stumps from wide of the crease, the batsman defends it back to the bowler
bowls a slower yorker wide outside off, Dhoni has to wait for it and then it sneaks under the bat
slightly on the pads and the batsman is able to flick it towards the vacant square leg region, they come back for a couple
quicker delivery on the stumps, Jadeja pushes it to midwicket
he goes on the front foot and punches the flatter delivery to deep cover
tossed up delivery on off stump, the batsman comes forward and drives it down to long on
pushed through outside off, Jadeja comes forward and defends it to cover

tossed up slider that hits the batsman on the knee roll off the back pad while Badrinath was deep in his crease, he should have come perhaps forward to that one. The umpire reckons the ball would have hit the leg stick
length delivery outside off, Badrinath chops it fine on the off side for a single
attempts a slower delivery, but it is a low full toss wide outside off, the batsman slices it towards point where Rohit makes an excellent diving stop
fuller delivery on the stumps, Dhoni nudges it to midwicket for a single
length ball outside off, Badri drives it to deep cover
fuller length delivery outside off, the batsman tries to whip it to the leg side, but gets an inside edge that goes past off stump and to the keeper on the bounce
now he bowls short of length outside off, Badri tries to guide it third man but is beaten
he bowls this one down the leg side and is called a wide
takes a forward stride to a full and flighted delivery and drives it to deep cover for a single
slightly shorter and on the stumps, the batsman goes deep in the crease and helps it on its way to deep backward square
pushed through on the stumps, the batsman defends it towards midwicket
pushed through outside off, he comes forward and drives it to deep cover

he gets out off the next ball as DK holds on to a brilliant low catch behind the stumps. The ball was similar to the previous one, flighted and full outside off, the batsman tried to launch it over extra cover again but gets a thin edge and the keeper takes a low catch on the second attempt

oh that has been dropped too! by Ponting this time. It was tossed up on off and Bravo drives it in the air towards extra cover where Ponting jumps up and gets his one hand to it, but is not able to hold on to it
now he comes forward to a fuller length delivery outside off and creams it to deep extra cover for a couple
short of length delivery outside off, Badrinath waits for it and guides it through slip with a gentle upper cut
he bowls an offcutter this time, the batsman gets squared up a bit as he plays this towards point
he bowls it short and wide outside off, Bravo tries to punch it over extra cover but gets beaten as he plays inside the line
back of length delivery delivery on off, the batsman waits and guides it to third man
bowls a gentle length ball outside off, the batsman punches it down to long off
fuller length delivery on the pads, Bravo comes forward and drives it down the ground to long on
another quick slider which the batsman tries to whip to the leg side, gets an inside edge on to his pads
he goes on the back foot and drops the flatter delivery on the leg side for a quick single, DK runs towards it and throws it towards the bowler, but they make it in time
bowls the slider this time, the batsman goes deep in the crease and pushes it to deep cover
another flatter delivery on off stump, the batsman goes back in his crease and nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single
bowls it flat and short outside off, Bravo punches it to deep cover off the back foot
bowls it with a lower trajectory, the batsman tries to work it to the leg side, but ends up defending it
flighted delivery on a length outside off, the batsman waits and opens the face to run it to deep backward point
tossed up delivery which is slower through the air, Hussey goes for a cross-batter hoick towards midwicket, but the ball sneaks under the bat to break the stump arrangement, big big wicket
flatter delivery on the stumps, Bravo tucks it off his pads to deep square leg
pushed through outside off, it goes straight on and beats Bravo's waft
pushed through on the stumps, Hussey dabs it towards square leg for a quick single
there to be cut, but his shot finds backward point, who fumbles but takes all pace off it
off the pad behind square
very full on off, he can't get a decent connection on it, it goes to midwicket
drives it to the sweeper
full delivery on the stumps, he slog sweeps, straight to the man at deep midwicket
spins away after being angled in on off, pushed behind point and they cross over quickly
tries the reverse paddle now, ends up playing it to point
gets something out of the over, skips out, lofts with the turn, over extra cover, wide of long off
tries to reverse sweep a full and wide one, but cannot beat the keeper
full, driven, but straight to extra cover
sees him coming down and bowls it quick into him, it pops up as Hussey defends
makes room and slaps a length ball to point
this one cuts into the batsman and flies between the bat and the pad, the keeper appeals along with the bowler, but the umpire turns it down, Bravo shakes his head too
bowls a cutter on stumps, Bravo goes on the back foot and works it through midwicket for a couple
he goes on the back foot and defends the length delivery to the off side

this was a length delivery on the stumps, the batsman tries to whip it to the leg side but gets an inside edge on to his pads, after which the ball lobs up towards point where Ponting completes a simple catch. Finally someone catches something off Johnson
here comes the short delivery and here goes Raina in a tangle, he somehow swats it towards midwicket, he didn't know whether to sway away or hit it, more of a delayed reaction
length delivery on off stump, the batsman turns it to square leg with some stylish wrist work
he carves a perfectly ok length delivery outside off with utmost ease through point this time
back of length and wide outside off, Raina doesn't try to smash it, but just pushes it in the gap at cover point
tries the same shot again, but this time he hits it straight to the mid-off fielder
length delivery on off stump, Raina comes forward and drives this on the up, straight down the ground all along the floor, beautiful shot
back of length delivery just outside off, Hussey easily chops it down to third man for a single
pushes this wide outside off and Hussey watches it go through to the keeper
length delivery outside off, Raina goes for a lofted straight drive straightaway, but doesn't time it too well and it stops before getting to the boundary

another drop, this one more of a regulation catch at first slip, it is Rohit Sharma! It was a length delivery outside off at which Hussey just pokes his bat, it flies low to the right of Rohit, who fluffs an easy chance. Mitchell Johnson is not impressed
fuller delivery aimed at off stump, the batsman is quick to come forward and he drives it to mid-off
back of length delivery wide outside off, the batsman tries to punch it without moving his feet, is beaten
length delivery on off stump, the batsman stays in the crease and defends it towards cover point
now he goes fuller, but this is on the middle and leg line, Hussey whips it past square leg with ease
he bowls a good quick short of length delivery that shapes away a touch, Hussey gets beaten but the pace and bounce on that
he hits timber this time! Vijay tries moving to the off side this time in an attempt to flick it fine on the leg side, but misses the line of the ball and it hits the top of leg stump. Munaf roars..
short of length delivery that follows the batsman as he makes room, Vijay tries to slap it to the leg side and gets beaten
length delivery on off and middle stump, the batsman comes forward and defends it to midwicket
back of length delivery, but this is angled on the pads and Vijay just nudges it to deep backward square leg
short of length delivery just outside off, the batsman cuts it to third man
bowls it fuller outside off, the batsman plays it towards mid-off with soft hands and calls for a quick single, the fielder charges in and hits the stumps, but they take an extra off the ricochet
short delivery, Hussey goes for an instinctive pull shot, doesn't get all on it, it goes to the right of square leg where Rayudu drops a touch chance, he dived one-handed and just palmed it away
length delivery, but on the pads and it is flicked down to fine leg with ease
short of length delivery angling across the right hander, Vijay goes on the back foot and defends it to the off side
length delivery, swinging in to the legs, the batsman misses it and it hits the pads

bowls a length delivery, but this on the pads and the batsman easily glances it fine on the leg side, it looked set for the boundary because Munaf was the man at fine leg, but he manages to keep it in somehow
bowls a quick short of length delivery outside off, the batsman guides it to third man off the back foot
